name: Extract shell from DWI image
summary: Extracts the volumes of one b-value shell from a DWI with MRtrix3 dwiextract, optionally keeping the b=0 volumes, and outputs a single-shell DWI with matching bvals and bvecs.
description: Runs MRtrix3 dwiextract with -shell set to the requested b-value (and to 0,b-value with the b=0 volumes when with_bzero is true). Use it to reduce multi-shell data to one shell for models or Apps that require single-shell input. Needs a DWI whose bvals contain the requested shell. Utility App.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvecs and bvals.
inputs.requirements: Must contain the requested b-value shell.

outputs.description: Single-shell DWI (dwi.nii.gz) with exported bvals and bvecs, including the b=0 volumes when with_bzero is true.

parameters.description: b-value of the gradient shell to extract.
If true (default), will include bzero volumes in extracted output. If false, will exclude.

failure_modes.cause: dwi/dwi.nii.gz was not produced by dwiextract.
failure_modes.fix: Check that bvals/bvecs match the DWI and, for shell extraction, that the requested shell exists.
